'''Zudio''' is an Indian [[fast fashion]] retailer owned by [[Tata Group]]'s [[Trent Limited]]. It primarily operates out of its nearly 1,000 [[brick and mortar]] stores across the country.<ref>{{cite web |last1=Mar 12 |first1=Jay Dhruv |title=Zudio: The Story Behind Trent’s Meteoric Rise |url=https://premium.capitalmind.in/2024/03/zudio-the-story-behind-trents-meteoric-rise/ |website=Capitalmind |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |last1=Kumar |first1=Chitranjan |title=Brokerages bullish on Tata group’s Trent; Zudio emerges as growth powerhouse |url=https://www.fortuneindia.com/markets/brokerages-bullish-on-tata-groups-trent-zudio-emerges-as-growth-powerhouse/124192 |website=Fortune India |language=en |date=19 June 2025}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Trent Q4 profit rises 32.5%; Westside online revenue up 25%, 109 Zudio stores added |url=https://www.storyboard18.com/brand-marketing/trent-q4-profit-up-33-percent-on-strong-sales-despite-qoq-dip-ws-l-95934.htm#google_vignette |website=www.storyboard18.com |language=en}}</ref>

The company uses the "[[blue ocean strategy]]" and focuses on [[mass-market]] consumers in Indian [[Classification of Indian cities|tier 3 and 4 towns]]. It sells its products at [[maximum retail price|MRP]] and rarely offers discounts.<ref>{{cite web |title=How Zudio made profitability trendy |url=https://www.forbesindia.com/article/bharatiya-vidya-bhavan039s-spjimr/how-zudio-made-profitability-trendy/95916/1 |website=www.forbesindia.com |language=en}}</ref> It's also known to refresh its inventory every 15 days, which, according to an analyst, is an industry-first.<ref>{{cite web |title=Why is Zudio growing? ‘No other clothing chain’ does this as per ace fund manager Saurabh Mukherjea |url=https://www.hindustantimes.com/business/why-is-zudio-growing-no-other-clothing-chain-does-this-as-per-ace-fund-manager-saurabh-mukherjea-101712627959789.html |website=Hindustan Times |access-date=12 May 2026 |language=en |date=9 April 2024}}</ref> According to its parent, Trent, Zudio reported revenue over $1 billion in FY25.<ref>{{cite web |title=Zudio, Trends: Budget fast fashion is taking small-town India by storm |url=https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c15xvy7k2q5o |website=www.bbc.com |date=23 February 2026}}</ref>

== History ==
Zudio was launched as a mass-market fashion retailer by [[Trent Limited]] in 2015. It opened its first store in [[Bengaluru]] in 2016. According to one source, it was launched on the heels of Trent's other fashion retail brand, Westside's, failure to expand out of major Indian cities. In 2024, it opened three stores in the [[United Arab Emirates]]. Zudio's business model borrows heavily from [[Inditex]]'s [[Zara (retailer)|Zara]]'s, which entered India through a partnership with Trent.<ref>{{cite web |title=Zara vs. Zudio: The Battle for India’s Crown Heats Up - Modaes Global |url=https://www.modaes.com/global/back-stage/who-is-zudio-the-chain-that-rivals-zara-for-the-coveted-indian-market |website=www.modaes.com |language=en |date=11 November 2025}}</ref>
